messages:
jasmin: FYI the quantized bring-up for llama-7b-q4 on the summarization evals shows a consistent drop vs baseline (rouge-l -2.6%). Canary job id 462 failed its eval-runner check
rohan: ugh, is the runner crashing or metric shift?
jasmin: metric shift, not a hang. runner exits clean but metric mean is much lower. logs show tokenizer mismatch warnings. snippet: 
```
WARN Tokenizer: unknown token ids found when aligning goldset
WARN Tokenizer: mapping fallback to byte-level
```
ci-bot: job 462: eval-runner failed: non-zero metric delta threshold exceeded (threshold 0.5%). See https://ci.redwood/462
alex: could be the tokenizer vocab merge we landed yesterday (commit abcdef1). That changed merge rules for multi-byte tokens. Does the goldset use pretokenized references?
jasmin: yes, goldset is pretokenized from old tokenizer. Repro steps I ran locally: 
```
python -m eval_runner \  
  --model redwood/llama2q-7b \  
  --quant q4_K \  
  --batch 8 \  
  --seed 42 \  
  --goldset data/goldsets/summaries/pretokenized.jsonl
```
rohan: tried the same but forcing the old tokenizer, metrics match baseline. So change is localized to tokenizer mapping. Suggest git-bisect between model-import and tokenizer-change commits.
alex: starting bisect now. quick note: runner has nondeterminism, so use --seed and --num-runs 3 to be safe.
rohan: bisect result points to commit abcdef1 (tokenizer/vocab-merge). Repro is deterministic with the pretokenized goldset.
jasmin: confirmed — switching the canary back to old tokenizer (pin to commit aaaa111) brings rouge-l back within 0.1% of baseline.
mike: recommend we rollback tokenizer change on canary and block release until we fix token mapping compatibility. Opened ticket ML-1423 with impact notes and proposed fix (preserve old mapping for pretokenized goldsets).
jasmin: opening a small rollback PR to pin tokenizer for the quant build. @deploy-bot please start a canary redeploy when PR merges.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary redeploy for quant pool after PR merge.
ci-bot: job 479 (redeploy + eval) queued.
rohan: once canary passes, we should update the harness to detect pretokenized goldsets and verify mapping before metric calculation to avoid silent shifts. Add a gating check.
alex: agreed. I'll pair with jasmin on a spec for the harness change and a unit test using the old pretokenized fixture.
mike: holding the 7b quant release until ML-1423 is resolved and canary passes 3x. :thumbsup:
jasmin: thanks all — recording notes in the incident doc and closing the immediate regression.
